verdict.rationale: Claude Code is a proprietary CLI that requires an Anthropic API key or Claude.ai/Console login (claude-code-docs-37, -39, -40) — there is no documented way to run the core model/service on one's own infrastructure. Community evidence explicitly contrasts it with FOSS alternatives, confirming it is closed-source and not self-hostable (claude-code-comm-3: 'Codex CLI is FOSS, unlike Claude Code').
